violations.description: Demonstration of knowledge by person in charge. — --Person in charge did not demonstrate adequate knowledge of the food service code requirements. When asked about reheating procedures, person in charge said soups were placed on low and were warmed for multiple hours before checking temperature. When reheating potentially hazardous foods, they should be heated to 165F with in 1 hour.

Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. Multiple boxes of food found on the floor in the walk-in freezer in the kitchen. Food items should be stored at least 6 inches off of the floor.

General equipment and utensils - Maintenance and operation. — --Nonfood contact equipment/utensil was not maintained in a good repair or sound condition. Base for the hand washing sink and shelving under the hot hold units were found constructed of porous materials that are worn and in disrepair. Equipment should be maintained in good repair.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Food contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Employee stated that Frazil machines are cleaned anywhere between weekly to monthly. Frazil machines should be cleaned at least once a week.--Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Pizza prep table found with debris between the lids on top of the table and along the window next to this prep table. These areas should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not clean or not cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Wall behind the hand washing sink, near ceiling, and light fixtures and ceiling were found dusty. These areas should be cleaned and maintained clean. Flooring under equipment throughout the kitchen was found with build up. Flooring should be more thoroughly cleaned.
Preventing contamination during storage. — --Food item was not stored in a clean, dry location a minimum of 6 inches above the floor. - Boxes stacked on floor of walk-in freezer

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. - Splash guard/skirt in large ice machine needs cleaning
Toilet facilities. — --Toilet room was not provided with a tight fitting or self closing door. - Bathroom doors need to be self closing
